hard_gaps: Pragmatic Play files no audited accounts anywhere. Revenue, EBITDA and valuation are unknown. Every figure circulating online traces to unattributed or AI-generated sources.
No authoritative global slot-studio GGR-share table exists. Section 'Supplier share' assembles four independent proxies that disagree because they measure different things.

No credible public figure exists for bonus buy's share of slot GGR. The widely circulated '15-25%' has no named source.
Play'n GO, PG Soft, Relax, Push, Jili, TaDa, Thunderkick and Greentube disclose no standalone revenue.

rows.beneficiary: PG Soft, Jili, TaDa Gaming, Fa Chai

rows.evidence: Expanding from 5 studios to 9 and 500 tables to 1,500+, into a vertical where Evolution's live revenue fell 3.6% YoY in Q2 2026 and Light & Wonder exited entirely in 2025.
rows.size: Structurally a Playtech/Evolution-shaped cost base being built as the live land-grab ends.

rows.evidence: Big Bass Splash, Gates of Olympus and Big Bass Bonanza are the three most widely distributed slots on earth. Two of the three are Reel Kingdom content — a separate studio, however tightly bound.
rows.size: Distribution footprint rests on a narrow IP base whose top title commands just 1.35% of European slot GGR.
rows.beneficiary: Any studio with an emergent franchise — ELK's Pirots, Games Global's Area Link

rows.evidence: AGCO fined Arrise Solutions CAD $40,000 on 7 May 2026 for games on unregulated sites reachable from Ontario. Named in the Los Angeles City Attorney's action against Stake.us. First major supplier to quit US sweepstakes (2 Sep 2025). Geo-blocked Dutch IPs on unlicensed casinos in 2026, removing ~29% of the top offshore slot inventory overnight.
rows.size: The UKGC took £4.75m from Evolution in July 2026 for exactly this conduct and stated it considered suspending the licence. Pragmatic's content is far more widely distributed on offshore sites than Evolution's, and as a private company it discloses nothing about its compliance posture.
rows.beneficiary: Studios with a US-regulated-first distribution model

rows.detail: 18-month licence review found 'serious weaknesses' in AML risk assessment and supply-chain oversight; five Evolution games were on six unlicensed sites serving GB consumers. rows.target: Arrise Solutions (Pragmatic Play) and Relax Gaming
rows.detail: Games found available on unregulated sites accessible to Ontario players. Both cooperated and restricted access. This is the only confirmed monetary penalty against Pragmatic Play found in this research.
Criminalises the full sweepstakes supply chain including content suppliers who knowingly support an online sweepstakes game.

First major supplier to withdraw from US sweepstakes, days after the Los Angeles City Attorney named it alongside Evolution, Hacksaw, Nolimit City, Red Tiger, BTG and NetEnt in an action against Stake.us. Games were locked rather than removed.

Began blocking Dutch IPs on unlicensed casinos. Blask measured the impact at 25 of the top 86 slots and 28 of the top 100 games on Dutch offshore lobbies — roughly 29% of top offshore slot inventory removed in one move. Neither Pragmatic nor the Ksa commented.
Software providers, platform providers and payment processors must block access from Romania via unlicensed operators. A EUR 20,000/year Class 2 B2B licence is now mandatory.
From 2028 Finnish-licensed operators may only use software from Finnish-licensed suppliers.

crypto.note: The $81.4bn category estimate would make crypto casinos larger than the entire regulated global online casino market, which strains credulity. The conservative methodology gives $9-14bn for 2023. Do not chart the high figure next to regulator-verified GGR. What is not in doubt: Pragmatic Play, Evolution, Hacksaw, Nolimit City, Play'n GO, NetEnt, BTG, Push, Relax, Red Tiger and Thunderkick all supply Stake.com today — the same roster that supplies regulated Europe.
